headline: JustMem reports adaptive long-term memory access with higher benchmark accuracy and lower model-token use
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces JustMem, a long-term conversational-memory system that adapts retrieval breadth and source-reading fidelity to each query. In author-run tests using GPT-4.1-mini across LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, it reports the best mean accuracy among the compared memory systems while using fewer generative-model tokens. Results are paper-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
